Description.Name: Nobility Line
Description.Details: A short while later, the Argo pulls into the Bonavista system. Sumire takes the Leopard to scan ahead at the coordinates that were discovered at the Tincalunas site. In a short while, the eager Leopard crew disembarks and quickly opens the large bay doors in order to escape the bitter polar winds. Darius probes, "Did you find anything guys?" Sumire is a bit stunned but manages to slip a response, "Yes, it's C-Bills! And there's a note, it says...Here's a little gas money." You straighten up and say, "Hey, every little bit helps! Yang you're awful quiet, is everything alright?" "Oh, for sure! I'm good" Yang answers distractedly. Dr. Murad smiles, "He's already playing around in a BlackJack Commander."

Description.Name: Continue
Description.Details: Yang chirps back, "Well someone has to do it. This is a bit of a mix from the last two. It has another top notch Rangefinder, an AMS unit and another ECM. I don't know where this guy is finding this stuff but it looks brand new?" Darius responds, "Each mech is bigger than before. That's still less than half the total weight Commander. If this pattern holds, we might end up with an Assault mech at the end of this?" You counter, "Or maybe a couple of heavies? It is a bit of a leap but it sounds like we might only have two more stops to make?" "Yeah, this thing has an XL Engine too. It looks refurbished. Maybe this guy is a scavenger boss?" Dr. Murad shakes her head at Yang, "The level of technology we've seen so far means that this person or people know their way around LosTech. Maybe they are ex-Comstar?" Yang shrugs, "I'm just as flabberghasted as you Dr. Murad. Endo-Steel, SLDF weaponry. It doesn't make any sense. Even ex-Comstar wouldn't just give this stuff away. All I can say for sure is that this mech is a bonafide sniper. Just park it far from the action and let it loose." Darius replies, "Well done crew! Let's grab the booty and the next set of coordinates." Dr. Murad already working fervently on a nearby panel, "Here we are. The next system is Linhauiguan." Sumire smiles, "Another nearby system. Let's do this!" Looking around the bridge, you agree, "To Linhauiguan we go!"
